package.name: cobot_vision
package.description: Geometry half of the vision pipeline (the ML half is cobot_detector, C++): localization_node — owns the /vision/scan action: calls /vision/detect (cobot_detector), then fitted camera→robot calibration (px + depth → base-frame xyz, calibration.py), rz from corners, snake ordering → TargetArray. Owns the calibration math services (begin/sample/compute; task_manager drives the robot between them, the dot is found through /vision/detect with the calibration model) and the cheap tier-1 depth checks (VerifyTarget, GetLayerHeight). Refuses to localize uncalibrated. No ML dependencies. Training/export tools live in vision_workspace/tools/ (dev-PC .venv), not here.
